html:
If you are looking for an upcoming vacation, what is so attractive about the coastal city, so to see and admire the unique events and festivals, let’s travel with Vietlook to Da Nang tourism on the occasion of April 30 today.

Traveling Da Nang on the occasion of April 30 – May 1 knocks on the door to bring you the most enjoyable experiences, this is one of the brilliant destinations in the summer, you will immerse yourself in the jubilant atmosphere of the festival.

It can be said that Da Nang is the place where many brilliant festivals take place, especially on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, which wants to invite tourists to visit and enjoy, this is one of the wonderful experiences, where so many beautiful cultural exchanges and the rhythm of life of the coastal city.

This year’s beach tourism season will take place on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, this year’s beach tourism season takes place with many art events taking place on the sea and many games taking place on the sea, promising to bring visitors a fun April 30 – May 1 holiday in the coastal city.

Ba Na Hills Sunflower Festival

Taking place with many unique programs, along with exciting art programs filled with brilliant sunflowers, flowers blooming brightly, stretching a brilliant yellow color, in addition, when coming to Ba Na, visitors should check in at the hand bridge, especially early in the morning with the floating mist next to the blooming flowers.

Join the game at Da Nang Downtown

Da Nang Downtown is one of the vibrant key combinations right in the center of Da Nang city, if you travel to Da Nang on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, visitors should come to Downtown, visitors can also participate in exciting games, or visit the night market, visitors can not only visit but also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, at the market there is also a buffet restaurant with a rich menu and a very beautiful view, it can be said that this is an ideal stopover during the April 30 holiday in Da Nang.

Street festivals take place on Bach Dang

The vibrant street festivals take place on Bach Dang street during the April 30 holiday, if you come to Da Nang on this occasion, visitors will dress up as funny characters and go with the group to the vibrant music, which will bring visitors the most unforgettable vacation.

In addition, when traveling to Da Nang on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, visitors can also experience swimming at My Khe beach, Non Nuoc beach and participate in sea games such as rowing, surfing, jet skiing… and visit the famous sites Ngu Hanh Son, Linh Ung Pagoda, Man Thai fishing village…

Visiting Helio Center Da Nang night market, you will immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Da Nang during the holiday and enjoy the delicious dishes of the city, especially at the night market, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, Da Nang specialties.

It can be said that when traveling to Da Nang on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, visitors cannot miss delicious dishes such as: rice paper rolls with pork, Quang noodles, fish cake noodles… or fresh seafood that will make visitors remember forever during the holiday.

Notes when traveling to Da Nang on the occasion of April 30.

Especially for those who travel to Da Nang on their own, you should proactively book a room early to avoid running out of rooms.

Book car services and means of transportation to Da Nang as soon as possible.

However, Da Nang April 30 is a summer holiday, so when coming to Da Nang on this occasion, you need to bring sunscreen and swimsuits to have a memorable vacation with friends and relatives. So traveling to Da Nang April 30 is not only a trip but also an opportunity for you to explore the beauty and immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere. Plan your trip to Da Nang today to have the best experiences.
